new_defects.title: A page reload during an export's corpus phase silently drops the large-data copy the user ticked; the reopened dialog still reads 'Backup complete' and 'Verified'
new_defects.repro:
1. Encrypted install whose LLM models store holds files (here HF_HOME=/tmp/claude-0/rewalk/J/fake-hf, shown as 'LLM models (3 files · 2.9 MB)', ticked by default).
2. Settings → Data & backup → Export / Back up…
3. Destination /tmp/claude-0/rewalk/J/exports-reload-models and a passphrase. Leave LLM models ticked and 'Carry them inside the encrypted backup' unticked. Click 'Back up'.
4. As soon as #ux-progress reads 'Corpus: Preparing…', reload the page (F5).
5. Wait for /api/backup/v2/volumes/status to reach done, then reopen the dialog and list the folder.
new_defects.expected: The large-data copy the user asked for still runs to completion server-side, or the reopened dialog says this export is INCOMPLETE: the LLM models were requested and not copied, with a way to finish. The app's own comment (app-backup.js, _uxShowLastCompletedExportSummary) says a long export's tab is very likely closed or reloaded before it finishes, so this is the realistic case, not an edge.
new_defects.actual:
202609270849_OpenOmniscience_Backup holds only volumes.json, par-00001.oopar, 4 .ooenc and BACKUP_SUMMARY.md. It has no hf_models/ and no oo-folder-backup.json. /api/backup/folder/status still names the OLDER drive/202609270847 export: the copy was never started. /api/jobs lists nothing.

The reopened dialog reads 'Backup complete → …/202609270849_OpenOmniscience_Backup (last completed export)', then a clean 'Verified — all 4 volumes were re-read and matched their checksums.' and 'Files copied: no files'. There is no 'Included:' line, no Resume, and nothing that says LLM models were asked for. BACKUP_SUMMARY.md says 'Files copied: none.' The corpus is intact; the requested member is missing with no signal.
new_defects.evidence: /tmp/claude-0/rewalk/J/results/reloadmid_models.json (checklist_at_click shows ux-c-models checked; folder_status_after; listing; summary_head; jobs); /tmp/claude-0/rewalk/J/shots/reloadmid-models-reopen-en.png, reloadmid-models-reopen-bottom-en.png
new_defects.root_cause_lead: src/static/app-backup.js:715-817 (_uxRun). The large-data phase is started only by the page: POST /api/backup/folder/start at :810, issued after the corpus poll resolves. The corpus job's start (:786) is not told which categories were requested unless 'inside' is ticked, and what the export includes lives only in page memory (_uxExportIncluded, :759). A reload between the phases therefore loses phase two. _uxShowLastCompletedExportSummary (:84-122, _uxPickLastExport :62) then presents the finished corpus job as the completed export. Possible fixes: have the server chain the folder phase after the volume job (pass categories with volumes/start), or record the requested members server-side so a reopen can say which part is missing.

walk.summary:
Row J re-walked on the fixed build 0deff9c4: encrypted, locked at boot, unlocked through #pw/#btn-unlock, airplane mode on throughout.

J1 to J6 pass in en, and J5 also in fr, ar and zh. A 375 px pass in en and ar shows no overflow. J7 and J8 are not-measurable-here: they need the operator's own install and a removable drive. Their sandbox equivalents on /tmp/claude-0/rewalk/J/drive all pass (folder name, Verified panel, a summary whose figures equal volumes.json's, a command line identical to the summary's).

All nine row-J defects are fixed:
- J1: the reopened dialog now names the latest export.
- J2: the job writes BACKUP_SUMMARY.md itself.
- J3: export dialog paths are LTR in Arabic.
- J4: the first export carries the signing key.
- J5: the plaintext wording is consistent.
- J6: 'Verifying volumes… · N of M volumes' is shown.
- J7: the hovers are translated.
- J8: the manual bullet is whole.
- J9: the named wording nits are fixed.
The related other-row defects are fixed too: O1, O5/P1 (the hover bubble is now drawn inside the modal), P8 (units localised) and U4 (Help at 375 px).

Three new defects:
- P2: a reload during the corpus phase silently drops the large-data copy the user ticked, and the reopened dialog still says 'Backup complete' and 'Verified'.
- P3: the Browse… folder picker reorders the path and the dated folder names in Arabic, J3's class on a surface its fix did not touch.
- P3: wording on the export surface. Arabic still names parity, the corpus and volumes two ways, its completion arrow points back at the label, and zh wraps a translated phrase in ASCII parentheses.

No page, console or HTTP error, and no request left loopback.

items.ref: new:A page reload during an export's corpus phase silently drops the large-data copy the user ticked; the reopened dialog still reads 'Backup complete' and 'Verified'
items.evidence:
Reproduced on my own instance: a fresh encrypted seed at /tmp/claude-0/rewalk/J-recheck/data-enc, nothing copied. Port 8956 started locked and I unlocked it through #pw/#btn-unlock. I used my own synthetic HF_HOME store (3 files, 2.9 MB) and stayed in airplane mode throughout.

CONTROL, no reload (results/control-1440x950.json). With Corpus and LLM models ticked and inside unticked, the progress ran 'Corpus: … → Large data: … → Backup complete → …/drive/202609271124_OpenOmniscience_Backup' and then 'Included: Corpus · LLM models'. That folder holds hf_models/ and oo-folder-backup.json, and the panel says 'Files copied: hf_models 3 files · 2.9 MB'.

RELOAD (results/reload-1440x950.json). pre_reload.at_click shows ux-c-models checked and ux-c-inside unchecked. I reloaded as soon as the progress read 'Corpus: Preparing…'. Afterwards the volumes status reported done for exports-reload-models/202609271124_OpenOmniscience_Backup. After another 8 s, /api/backup/folder/status still named the OLDER drive/202609271124_OpenOmniscience_Backup (started_at 1790501078.68, before this export's 1790501098.80). /api/jobs was empty. server.log shows export-folder and volumes/start for this export and NO POST /api/backup/folder/start after them.

The folder lists only BACKUP_SUMMARY.md, par-00001.oopar, 4 .ooenc and volumes.json: no hf_models/ and no oo-folder-backup.json. BACKUP_SUMMARY.md says 'Files copied: none.'

The reopened dialog shows 'Backup complete → …/202609271124_OpenOmniscience_Backup (last completed export)', then 'Verified — all 4 volumes…' and 'Files copied: no files'. It has no 'Included:' line and no Resume (the #ux-pause display is none). The checklist still shows LLM models ticked. Screenshots: shots/reload-models-reopen-en.png and reload-models-reopen-bottom-en.png. No page errors, console errors or HTTP >= 400.

This is not a harness artifact: the reload was a plain page.reload() at a moment any user can hit. No ruling or manual text tells the user to keep the tab open, and the app's own comment at app-backup.js:71-80 says a reload is the likely case.
items.root_cause:
src/static/app-backup.js:807-813. The browser's _uxRun closure is the only thing that starts the large-data phase (POST /api/backup/folder/start), and only after it has polled the corpus phase to done (:784-805). A reload destroys that closure, so the copy never starts.

The server never learns the copy was requested. POST /api/backup/export-folder (src/api/backup_v2.py:592-613) records only the parent folder. /v2/volumes/start gets include_blobs only in the 'inside' case (app-backup.js:786-788; VolumeBackupBody at backup_v2.py:455-466).

On reopen, _uxShowLastCompletedExportSummary (app-backup.js:81-148, the line at :122) treats the volume job's done as a completed export. _uxExportIncluded (:835) died with the page and nothing server-side holds the request, so no 'Included:' line and no incomplete state can be drawn. export_facts can only describe what is on disk.
items.suggested_fix:
Make the export one server-side job, the way the import queue was after ruling item 16. Pass the requested members (corpus, categories, inside) with the folder allocation or with /v2/volumes/start, and have the volume manager start the folder copy into the same dest when the corpus phase completes.

At minimum, persist the request inside the dated folder (for example oo-export-request.json, written at allocation). The reopened dialog and export_facts can then compare requested with present and show 'Incomplete: LLM models were requested and not copied', with a button that starts /api/backup/folder/start into the same dest. BACKUP_SUMMARY.md should name the missing member too, instead of 'Files copied: none.'

items.ref: new:Arabic (RTL): the Browse… folder picker reorders the path and the dated export folder names (J3's class, on the picker)
items.evidence:
My own drive folder holds 202609271124_OpenOmniscience_Backup and _2, both real exports. I reached it through Browse…, the ⬆ row up to /, then down through the folder rows. The positions below were measured from the layout with Range.getClientRects (results/picker-1440x950.json and picker-375x812.json).

In ar, #fp-path has computed direction rtl and dir attribute null. The leading '/' sits at x=979, to the right of the last character 'e' of drive at x=972, so the line reads 'tmp/claude-0/rewalk/J-recheck/drive/'.

In the folder rows the date is drawn to the RIGHT of the name (date_x 834 > name_x 627), which reads 'OpenOmniscience_Backup_202609271124'. In the _2 row the '2' is at x=817, between the name (x=610) and the date (x=834): 'OpenOmniscience_Backup_2_202609271124'. At 375 px it is the same (slash at x=336 vs last char at x=329; date at 214 vs name at 8 and -9).

fr, zh and en: date_left_of_name is true and the slash is leftmost. #ux-dest receives the correct value in every language (dir=ltr).

Screenshots: shots/picker-ar-1440x950.png, picker-ar-375x812.png, picker-path-ar-*.png and picker-list-ar-*.png, with picker-fr-*.png as the control. No page, console or HTTP errors.
items.root_cause:
The completion line got dir="ltr" for J3 (app-backup.js:122); the shared picker never did.
- src/static/app-map.js:285 sets $("fp-path").textContent = d.path, and index.html:3438 gives #fp-path no dir.
- app-map.js:288 renders `📁 ${esc(e.name)}` inside an RTL-inherited div with no LTR isolate.

Under the bidi algorithm the leading '/' and the digit run take the paragraph's RTL direction, so they are placed apart from the Latin run.
items.suggested_fix: Give #fp-path dir="ltr" (index.html:3438, or set $("fp-path").dir = "ltr" at app-map.js:285), with text-align:start or right so it still sits on the RTL side. Wrap each entry name in `<bdi dir="ltr">${esc(e.name)}</bdi>` (app-map.js:288), keeping the icon and the row's RTL alignment. The picker is shared (maps, data folder, import), so this fixes every caller.

The zoom (shots/wording-ar-arrow-zoom.png) shows the arrow pointing right, back at 'اكتمل النسخ الاحتياطي'. Other ar strings use ← (for example 'تحليل ←'). (d) zh. items.root_cause:
- (a) src/static/locales/ar.json: 'Writing parity…' is 'جارٍ كتابة بيانات التماثل…', used at app-backup.js:479. 'Parity (corruption recovery)' and the index.html:3340 hint use تكافؤ. Other parity keys also say تماثل ('Back up (volumes + parity)', '(volumes only — parity needs the analysis features)').
- (b) ar.json's value for the index.html:1952 intro ('One place to back up everything…') was not aligned when J9 was fixed.
- (c) ar.json 'Backup complete →' keeps U+2192, which is not bidi-mirrored.
- (d) src/static/app-backup.js:122 hardcodes ` (${esc(t("last completed export"))})`, so no locale can supply its own brackets. The count brackets at :385 and :406 follow the same pattern.
items.suggested_fix:
- ar.json: use تكافؤ for every parity key, for example 'جارٍ كتابة بيانات التكافؤ…'.
- Reword the intro to 'المجموعة المشفّرة كوحدات + تكافؤ'.
- Use 'اكتمل النسخ الاحتياطي ←'.
- Replace the hardcoded brackets with a keyed frame, such as tf('({what})', …) or a key '(last completed export)', so zh can render '（上次已完成的导出）'. Do the same for the checklist count frames at app-backup.js:385 and :406.

items.ref: new:At 375 px the folder picker clips export folder names: the _2 suffix that tells two same-minute exports apart is hidden (and in Arabic the start of the name is cut)
items.evidence:
Met on the way; not in the walker's list. At 375x812 (results/measure375.json) #fp-list has overflow-x auto with scrollWidth 348 against clientWidth 303. The rows measure scrollW 331 and 348 against clientW 303, with white-space normal.

In fr, en and zh both rows are drawn as '202609271124_OpenOmniscience_Bac' (shots/picker-fr-375x812.png). They look identical unless the user scrolls the list sideways, and nothing signals that it scrolls.

In ar the start is cut instead: 'enOmniscience_Backup_202609271124' and 'Omniscience_Backup_2_202609271124' (shots/picker-ar-375x812.png, picker-start-ar-375.png). The page itself does not overflow (document scrollWidth equals 375).
items.root_cause: src/static/app-map.js:288: each .fp-row is a plain div with no overflow-wrap. An underscore-joined folder name has no break opportunity, so it overflows into #fp-list's horizontal scroll (index.html:3439, overflow:auto). The path line above already has word-break:break-all (index.html:3438); the rows have nothing equivalent.
items.suggested_fix: Add overflow-wrap:anywhere (or word-break:break-all) to the .fp-row style at app-map.js:287-288, together with the LTR <bdi> wrapper from the Arabic picker fix. The full name then wraps inside the row in every language.

recheck.summary:
I re-checked row J's three items independently on build 0deff9c4, and all three are confirmed. I seeded a fresh encrypted corpus into /tmp/claude-0/rewalk/J-recheck/data-enc (nothing copied from the walker) and made my own synthetic 3-file Hugging Face model store. The server on port 8956 (PID 17853) booted locked and I unlocked it through the real #pw/#btn-unlock form. It stayed in airplane mode the whole time: no page request left 127.0.0.1, no consent popup appeared, and the server logged no response >= 400. I stopped it by PID, and git status of the tree and the repo is clean. Everything is under /tmp/claude-0/rewalk/J-recheck/ (recheck.py, measure375.py, results/*.json, shots/*.png, server.log).

1. **Reload drops the large-data copy (P2): confirmed.** A reload during 'Corpus: Preparing…' with LLM models ticked finishes the corpus server-side, but the model copy never starts. The server log has no folder/start call, the folder has no hf_models/, and the folder status still names an older export. The reopened dialog reads 'Backup complete → … (last completed export)' and 'Verified', with no 'Included:' line and no Resume. The cause is that the browser alone sequences the second phase (src/static/app-backup.js:807-813), and nothing server-side records that the copy was requested (backup_v2.py:592).

2. **Arabic folder picker reorders paths and names (P3): confirmed.** Measured from the layout: in ar the path is drawn with its leading slash at the far end, and the export folder names read date-last, with the _2 suffix in the middle. fr, zh and en are unaffected. Cause: no dir="ltr" on #fp-path and no LTR isolate on the row names (app-map.js:285-288).

3. **Export wording (P3): confirmed on all four points.**
   - The Arabic progress line says التماثل for parity, while the panel and hint say التكافؤ.
   - The Arabic panel intro still says المتن and أجزاء, while the dialog says المجموعة and وحدات. That contradicts J9's own fix goal.
   - The Arabic completion arrow (→) points back at the label.
   - The zh completion line wraps the translated phrase in ASCII parentheses hardcoded at app-backup.js:122 (the checklist counts at :385 and :406 do the same).

**New P3 met on the way:** at 375 px the folder picker's rows overflow into a sideways scroll. In en, fr and zh this hides the _2 suffix, so two same-minute exports look identical; in ar it cuts off the start of the name.
